entities.summary: Antonius "Ton" Maria Richter was a Dutch field hockey player who competed in the 1948 Summer Olympics. He was born in Blaricum. He was a member of the Dutch field hockey team, which won the bronze medal. He played all seven matches as goalkeeper.
